title: Artificial Intelligence-assisted Ultrasound Diagnosis of Musculoskeletal Injuries.
official: Artificial Intelligence-assisted Ultrasound Diagnosis of Musculoskeletal Injuries for Physiotherapy, Traumatology and Orthopaedic Practice (ECO-IA).
summary: The proposal combines clinical research in physiotherapy, traumatology and orthopaedics with artificial intelligence, computer vision and health-data science.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with musculoskeletal pain affecting tendons, muscles, ligaments or bursae

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with severe, acute pain consistent with an open fracture; surgical procedures in the area under examination and diagnosis. Uncooperative patients who do not sign the informed consent form.
